quests.title: Short Delivery, Menangle
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. The Menangle order has been two cartons light every week since a public holiday nobody remembered and the invoice says otherwise every time. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Menangle
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $117 owing to Menangle and it is not going to walk in here itself. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: $117, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Menangle Run
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. I do the Menangle run at first light and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Menangle Park
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Menangle
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. I have got a whiteboard with last March still on it in the back of the van and the Menangle shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. This is the third time I have had this conversation. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Menangle
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Three of the Menangle regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $26 down on those days. It started small, the way these things do. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$26, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Menangle
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Everything Menangle sells comes off a floor at Douglas Park, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us
